title: Spark Facilitator — Connect Pilot for FCAP Community Meeting Facilitation
description: A Connect verify-and-pay layer under Spark MicroGrants' Community Based Facilitators: each CBF records FCAP community meetings on a form built from Spark's Village Monitoring Form, and Connect pays per meeting verified as meeting_conducted = yes AND meeting_type = community_meeting, capped at 3 paid meetings per community per FCAP step. The pilot covers Goal Setting (steps 1-7, ~3 months) for ~12 communities in one Malawi district, with facilitator registration, per-meeting monitoring and savings in scope.
